## BOOKING - Messenger Inbox Poller
The Facebook Messenger twin of **Instagram Inbox Poller**: every 20 seconds it reads the Page's Messenger conversations and hands each new customer message to **Instagram Reply** (which answers on whichever channel the message came from) without waiting.
Uses the **Meta Page Access Token** credential, which needs the `pages_messaging` permission. Unpublish this workflow if the Messenger webhook in **Incoming Social Message** starts working, or customers get two replies.

meta.description: Polls the Instagram inbox every 20 seconds and answers new DMs; a fallback for the Meta messages webhook.
